## Datasets

::: {.res-grid}

::: {.res-card}
### [Seamless Interaction](https://ai.meta.com/research/seamless-interaction/)

Over 4,000 hours of face-to-face interaction footage from more than 4,000 participants in diverse contexts, built for social AI research.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.22554) [Open access](https://github.com/facebookresearch/seamless_interaction)
:::

::: {.res-card}
### [DynAMoS](https://dynamos.mgb.org)

Dynamic affective movie clips (22 clips) with metadata and ratings of their emotional content from 83 participants, built for subjectivity analysis.

[Paper](https://affcom.ku.edu/publications/proceedings/girard2023a.html) [Request access](https://dynamos.mgb.org)
:::

::: {.res-card}
### [GFT](http://osf.io/7wcyz)

Group Formation Task database: 2D video of spontaneous behavior during unscripted social interactions, with frame-level FACS annotations (96 participants).

[Paper](https://affcom.ku.edu/publications/proceedings/girard2017b.html) [Request access](http://osf.io/7wcyz)
:::

::: {.res-card}
### [MMSE / BP4D+](http://bit.ly/2yg39Cn)

Multimodal Spontaneous Emotion database: an extension of BP4D with thermal and physiological data and frame-level FACS annotations (140 participants).

[Paper](https://affcom.ku.edu/publications/proceedings/zhang2016.html) [Request access](http://bit.ly/2yg39Cn)
:::

::: {.res-card}
### [BP4D](http://bit.ly/2yg39Cn)

Binghamton-Pittsburgh 4D Spontaneous Emotion database: 3D video of spontaneous behavior during emotion elicitation, with frame-level FACS annotations (41 participants).

[Paper](https://affcom.ku.edu/publications/articles/girard2014c.html) [Request access](http://bit.ly/2yg39Cn)
:::

:::

## Statistics and Measurement

::: {.res-grid}

::: {.res-card}
[Stable]{.res-tag .stable}

### [circumplex](https://circumplex.jmgirard.com/)

R package for the analysis and visualization of circumplex data.
:::

::: {.res-card}
[Experimental]{.res-tag .experimental}

### [intraclass](https://jmgirard.github.io/intraclass/)

R package for modern intraclass correlation coefficients via generalizability theory and mixed-model variance components.
:::

::: {.res-card}
[Experimental]{.res-tag .experimental}

### [agreement](https://github.com/jmgirard/agreement)

R package for the tidy calculation of inter-rater reliability.
:::

::: {.res-card}
[Experimental]{.res-tag .experimental}

### [varde](https://github.com/affcomlab/varde)

R package for decomposing the variance in mixed effects models.
:::

::: {.res-card}
[Experimental]{.res-tag .experimental}

### [ackwards](https://jmgirard.github.io/ackwards/)

R functions for hierarchical factor structure development.
:::

::: {.res-card}
[Experimental]{.res-tag .experimental}

### [bsync](https://jmgirard.github.io/bsync/)

R package for behavioral synchrony analysis.
:::

::: {.res-card}
[Experimental]{.res-tag .experimental}

### [hitop](https://jmgirard.github.io/hitop/)

R package for working with Hierarchical Taxonomy of Psychopathology (HiTOP) data.
:::

::: {.res-card}
[Legacy]{.res-tag .legacy}

### [mReliability](https://mreliability.jmgirard.com)

MATLAB functions for computing inter-observer reliability.
:::

:::
